title: MemoryRecordsPromoteRequest
description: Explicit placement change of a retained record (context ↔ shared, or context → other context). Provenance is unchanged; promotion is the only path that changes placement and therefore invalidates reflections (MEM-R013). Grant: promote plus records_write covering both source and target placements. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

target_scope.description: Target placement; shared requires shared access. Source and target coverage are both required.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey
